desc_en: A clean silhouette defines this short sleeve midi dress. Tailored with a fitted cut that embraces the hips with precision. Designed with a classic crew neckline and short sleeves. The minimalist aesthetic delivers timeless elegance and versatility. An essential wardrobe piece for any occasion. Available exclusively made to order with worldwide shipping.

Su estética minimalista ofrece una elegancia atemporal y versatilidad. Una prenda esencial para la temporada. Disponible exclusivamente bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
